title: An M15 spike up while M5 is flat
why: Rule 2 (a snapback against the spike) for both trader types from MCD1's branch: the Day Trader because MCD1 is its primary sensor, the Scalper because the rows that say Both and name MCD1 apply to it as written (decision D1 (c)), MCD2 being a flat range with no branch of rule 2 of its own. Both get a SHORT. M15 up against M5 flat is a trend conflict at MCD3, so the modifier makes both readings CAUTIONARY.
